# grouper_group (Resource)

Manages a Grouper group. The parent stem must already exist; this resource does not create it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "grouper_stem" "cloud" {
  name         = "example:apps:myteam:example"
  display_name = "Example"
}

resource "grouper_group" "aws_admins" {
  name         = "${grouper_stem.cloud.name}:aws-admins"
  display_name = "AWS Administrators"
  description  = "Administrators of centrally managed AWS services"
}

# Import by UUID:
#   terraform import grouper_group.aws_admins 09b488181c7d42ba9eb880fd7ad698d3
#
# Import by full name:
#   terraform import grouper_group.aws_admins name:example:apps:myteam:example:aws-admins
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full colon-delimited system name of the group, e.g. `example:apps:myteam:aws-admins`. Changing this forces replacement.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the group.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display label for this group component (Grouper `displayExtension`). Defaults to the last path component if unset.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Grouper UUID of the group. Used as the stable Terraform identifier.
- `stem_name` (String) Full name of the parent stem, derived from `name`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by Grouper UUID:
terraform import grouper_group.aws_admins 09b488181c7d42ba9eb880fd7ad698d3

# Import by full group name (resolved to its UUID):
terraform import grouper_group.aws_admins name:example:apps:myteam:aws-admins
```
